answer: Make grading seats random and blind, then score graders against the eventual consensus. A raven perched over a market can count every stall, but cannot tell which merchant owns several. Likewise the network cannot see clones, yet it can notice when a cluster of accounts always grades the same pearl of text identically and early. Graders whose verdicts move together lose weight together, so a sybil farm shatters like crystal: each fake must think independently or the whole set is discounted.
